IdeoPresetDef.label: shadow raiders
IdeoPresetDef.description: In the darkness, the strong take what they can and the fallen sustain the living. Our beliefs must spread, even by force.

IdeoPresetDef.label: wandering scrappers
IdeoPresetDef.description: We travel light and never settle. The road's abandoned machines and ruins are tools for the next leg of our journey, and we find comfort in the darkness.

IdeoPresetDef.label: faceless seers
IdeoPresetDef.description: We conceal our identities and turn from ordinary sight. In blindness we perceive hidden truth, while anonymity shields us from the judgments of others.

IdeoPresetDef.label: dark anonymity
IdeoPresetDef.description: In the darkness, we guard our identities and turn our minds inward. Psychic discipline sharpens our focus without exposing who we are.
